verdict.rationale: Airbyte's core value proposition is a catalog of 600+ maintained connectors spanning APIs, databases, warehouses, and data lakes, backed by docs on sync modes, CDC, schema change handling, and incremental sync that demonstrate connector maturity. Community evidence corroborates real-world use across varied sources (custom large-table workarounds, self-hosted production use) though some gaps are noted (hard-delete sync questions, requests for specific destinations like pgvector). Missing for 10: independent connector-count audits or freshness/maintenance-quality benchmarks beyond vendor claims.
